lines.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A song.
His name is great in Israel.
There He shattered the flaming arrows,
the shield and sword and weapons of war.
more majestic than mountains filled with game.
The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep.
No men of might could lift a hand.
At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob,
both horse and rider lie stunned.

pictures.scene: Thomas Eakins, The Concert Singer — the singer standing out alone to sing before the players, for the choirmaster with stringed instruments a Psalm of Asaph a song, God is known in Judah
pictures.name: pd_eakins_concert_singer

pictures.scene: Gerard Houckgeest, Interior of the Nieuwe Kerk in Delft with the Tomb of William the Silent — the great church opened up around the tomb of the man it honors, His name is great in Israel, His tent is in Salem
pictures.name: pd_houckgeest_nieuwe_kerk_delft

pictures.scene: Bernardo Bellotto, View of Pirna from the Sonnenstein Castle — the town spread out below the fortress set on its height, His dwelling place in Zion, there He shattered the flaming arrows
pictures.name: pd_bellotto_pirna_sonnenstein

pictures.scene: Anthony van Dyck, Marchese Ambrogio Spinola — the commander standing in his armor with the baton of command in his hand, the shield and sword and weapons of war, Selah
pictures.name: pd_van_dyck_ambrogio_spinola

pictures.scene: Friedrich Gauermann, Der vordere Langbathsee mit dem Höllengebirge — the lake lying clear under the mountain range in full light, You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game
pictures.name: pd_gauermann_langbathsee_hoellengebirge

pictures.scene: Briton Rivière, Requiescat — the knight lying still in his armor with his hound keeping watch beside him, the valiant lie plundered they sleep their last sleep, no men of might could lift a hand
pictures.name: pd_riviere_requiescat

pictures.scene: January Suchodolski, Bitwa pod Somosierrą — the charge broken on the gun with horses and riders going down in the road, at Your rebuke O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned
pictures.name: pd_suchodolski_somosierra
